definitions.title: Agent definitions
definitions.help: An agent definition is the agent's logical configuration (role, instructions, default model). A provider account is the credential used for model calls — they are different concepts.

list.inUse: Definition in use — archive it instead.

archive.title: Archive definition
archive.body: The definition "{{name}}" will be archived: it can no longer be edited or used for new instances, but its history is preserved.

delete.title: Delete definition
delete.body: Delete the definition "{{name}}"? This action is permanent and only allowed because no agent instance uses it.

form.keyHint: Stable identifier: lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens.
form.stacksHint: Separate stacks with commas (e.g. React, TypeScript).
form.accountHint: A provider account is the credential (the secret stays in the backend); the definition only references which credential to prefer.
form.keyLocked: The technical identifier cannot be changed after the definition is created.
form.effortNoModel: Pick a model to see the supported effort levels.
form.effortMapped: The levels above reflect the mapping published by this model.
form.effortUnknown: This model publishes no effort mapping; the provider applies its own default.

steps.label: Definition steps
steps.reviewHelp: Check the data before creating. You can go back to any step.

roleHelp.chief: Coordinates the project: receives requests, creates demands and delegates tasks to specialists. One chief per project.
roleHelp.specialist: Performs a kind of work delegated by the chief (e.g. review, backend, data). There can be many.

models.body: No enabled model. Connect a provider and sync the catalog to pick the default model.

accounts.body: No provider account registered. The account holds the credential (as a secure reference), separate from the definition.

import.title: Start from a template
import.body: Download the JSON template, adjust it and import. The file becomes a draft in the form — nothing is created until you finish. Never include secrets: credentials belong to the provider account.

errors.title: The file could not be imported:
errors.notAnObject: The content must be a JSON object.
errors.forbiddenField: The field {{field}} is not accepted: definitions never carry secrets or account bindings.

name.description: Human-readable agent name, used across screens.
name.impact: Appears in the org chart, chat and audit records.

key.description: Stable technical identifier used in integrations and references.
key.impact: Generated from the name. Cannot be changed once created.

description.description: One sentence about what this agent does.
description.impact: Helps the chief decide whom to delegate to.

role.description: Chief coordinates the project; specialist performs delegated work.
role.impact: Defines whether the agent delegates or is delegated to.

specialty.impact: Used by the chief to match task and agent.

team.impact: Used to group and filter agents.

persona.description: How the agent behaves and communicates.
persona.placeholder: e.g. Senior engineer, objective, always backing decisions with evidence.

mission.description: The outcome this agent exists to guarantee.
mission.example: Ensure changes ship safe and tested.
mission.impact: Guides the agent's decisions under trade-offs.
mission.placeholder: e.g. Ensure no backend change reaches production without tests.

responsibilities.description: What the agent delivers, one per line.
responsibilities.example: Review diffs / Flag risks / Require tests

instructions.description: How to do the work, in priority order.
instructions.example: Prefer correctness over style. Cite file and line.
instructions.impact: Conflicting instructions reduce quality — be specific.
instructions.placeholder: e.g. Prefer correctness over style. Always cite file and line.

restrictions.description: What the agent must NOT do.
restrictions.example: Do not approve changes without tests.
restrictions.placeholder: e.g. Never approve without tests. Never change a public contract.

bestPractices.example: Actionable comments with a fix example.
bestPractices.placeholder: e.g. Every finding comes with a concrete fix suggestion.

stacks.description: Technologies the agent works with, comma separated.

skills.description: Catalog skills this agent may use.

tools.description: Tools the agent can invoke during execution.

defaultModel.description: Model used by default in this agent's runs.

defaultEffort.description: Default reasoning level sent to the provider.
defaultEffort.impact: Higher effort costs more and takes longer, with more elaborate answers.

preferredAccount.description: Preferred provider account for this agent.
preferredAccount.impact: The credential lives in the account, never in the definition.

actorCritic.description: Role in the actor/critic pair: who executes and who reviews.
actorCritic.impact: A critic reviews the actor's output before completion.

risk.description: Risk level of this agent's actions.
risk.impact: Higher risk tends to require more human review.

fallbackModels.description: Alternate models when the default is unavailable or out of quota.

agents.title: Project agents
agents.empty: No agents allocated to this project.

attempt.title: Attempt #{{number}}
attempt.empty: No events recorded for this attempt.

drain.title: Drain tasks
drain.description: In-progress tasks return to the Ready column, running attempts are cancelled and agents become idle.

handoff.title: Chief handoff
handoff.stepChoice: Step 1 of 2 — choose the new chief
handoff.reasonRequired: Enter the reason for the handoff.

mutation.error: The action could not be completed. Try again.

empty.title: No project selected
empty.body: Select a project to follow the orchestration.

explanations.notConfigured: The chief has no provider, model or workflow yet. Configure the dependencies to enable execution.
explanations.awaitingProvider: An enabled model with an active provider account is missing. Without it the chief cannot run.
explanations.awaitingWorkflow: Provider and model are ready. Link a workflow to the project to define phases and gates.
explanations.ready: Dependencies satisfied: the chief can run on this project.
explanations.running: The chief is running an attempt right now.
explanations.degraded: The chief is in error or out of quota. Review the agents before continuing.
